intro: Axil Corner Table is designed to command attention in subtle ways. Crafted from solid mango wood and finished in a deep black, it brings quiet confidence and sculptural presence to overlooked corners.

features.title: Solid, dependable build for lasting use
features.text: Axil is crafted entirely from solid mango wood for both the tabletop and understructure, ensuring strength and stability. This robust construction gives the table a grounded feel and dependable performance over time.

features.title: Deep black craftsmanship for a bold presence
features.text: Meticulously finished in a rich, deep black stain, the natural wood grain of this corner table remains visible beneath the surface. This careful treatment enhances depth and character while delivering a refined, premium look.

features.title: A touch of grandeur
features.text: The bold finish and sculptural form lend Axil a sense of quiet luxury. It elevates corners with a confident presence, adding drama without overwhelming the surrounding space

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
